summary.text: Jean Leising is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 42 since 2008, after an earlier period in the Senate from 1988 to 1996.
The caucus page lists her as chair of the Agriculture Committee and describes her occupation as farm owner, travel agent and retired nurse.

paragraphs.text: According to her Indiana Senate Republican biography, Leising graduated from Sunman High School in 1966 as salutatorian and from the Good Samaritan School of Nursing in Cincinnati, Ohio, with honors in 1969.
She served as Senate assistant majority whip from 1994 to 1996 and is a past president of the Indiana Corn Growers Association (1986) and a member of the Indiana Farm Bureau.
Her district covers Decatur, Fayette, Ripley and Rush counties and portions of Franklin, Jennings and Shelby counties.

She also serves on the Natural Resources, Commerce and Technology, Health and Provider Services, and Utilities committees, and the page lists her as married to Frank Thompson with three children and eight grandchildren.
